worker.outcomeSummary: Reworked migrateConfig so it reads a legacy document as a faithful reading: it first normalizes every key's spelling (case/separators plus the documented synonyms), rejects unrecognized keys and documents that name the same setting with more than one spelling (ambiguous), and validates each present value (non-empty name/endpoint, non-negative integer retries, positive timeout) — applying the v2 defaults only afterwards, for settings the document never mentioned.
